say: Quality is judged blind by a language model. Two hard checks back it up: the project must build and pass a smoke test, and it must do so on the first run.
phonemes: kwˈɔlᵻɾi ɪz dʒˈʌdʒd blˈaɪnd baɪ ɐ lˈæŋɡwɪdʒ mˈɑːdəl. tˈuː hˈɑːɹd tʃˈɛks bˈæk ɪɾ ˈʌp: ðə pɹˈɑːdʒɛkt mˈʌst bˈɪld ænd pˈæs ɐ smˈoʊk tˈɛst, ænd ɪt mˈʌst dˈuː sˌoʊ ɔnðə fˈɜːst ɹˈʌn.
